material:
# variant C: conditional layers, call/foreach, target SHELL handoff
MODE ?= dev
ifeq ($(MODE),dev)
  PAYLOAD := $(call wrap,dev)
  STEPS = one two
else ifdef CI
  STEPS = ci
else
  STEPS = never
endif
wrap = [$(1)-$(words $(STEPS))]
PAYLOAD2 = $(call wrap,late)
LIST := $(foreach s,$(STEPS),step_$(s))
ifndef UNSET_X
  STEPS += three
endif
.RECIPEPREFIX = >
deploy: $(LIST) ; @echo deploy
step_%:
>@echo $@
stage: SHELL := /usr/bin/python3
stage: .SHELLFLAGS := -c
stage: deploy
>print("$(PAYLOAD2)")
note: make-target-flow-variant-diff: ifeq/else ifdef/ifndef layers, $(foreach), `step_%` pattern rule, .RECIPEPREFIX
generator_cmd: python3 -I tests/data/script_fixtures/mkflow_gen.py tests/data/script_fixtures/  (stdlib str writer; variant B = A with `CHANNEL := stable` ahead of `CHANNEL ?= beta`, `all: launch report` -> `all: report launch`, no .DEFAULT_GOAL)
oracle_cmd: cd tests/data/script_fixtures/ && python3 -I mkflow_oracle.py order mkflow_variant_c.mk stage  (GNU make 4.4.1 -n --trace / --eval $(info ..) / -qp)
